name: Isabella I of Castile
short_desc: A Castilian queen whose joint rule with Ferdinand accompanied the conquest of Granada and the expulsion of Jews.
notes: New source-linked entry. The Wikipedia introduction, date evidence and article identity received an initial editorial check; independent claim-specific source review remains open.

periods.label: Queen of Castile
periods.date_note: Queen of Castile from 1474 until her death in 1504; this is separate from her title as queen of Aragon.
